::: {.why}
Every backtest you have run assumed a price existed; today you construct one from the individual orders that produced it, and the exercise permanently changes what a quote looks like to you.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Parse an ITCH sample and reconstruct the top of book for one symbol through a full session.
- Report the number of messages per second and the fraction that are cancellations.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>60 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [40 min]{.task-min} Write a parser for the ITCH message types you need: add order, order executed, order cancel, order delete and order replace. Ignore the rest. Feed them into your day 9 toy matching book, which was built for exactly this and has been waiting since week 2.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [20 min]{.task-min} Report three numbers for one liquid symbol: messages per second at the busiest minute, the fraction of orders that are cancelled before executing, and the median lifetime of an order that gets cancelled. The cancellation fraction is the number that surprises people and it is usually well above 90 percent.
:::
:::
